CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArraySort

Sorts a one-dimensional array numerically or alphabetically, ascending or descending. The array you pass is rearranged; nothing new is created.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArraySort(array, sort_type [, sort_order ])

Parameters

array
The array to sort.
sort_type
numeric (every element must be a number), text (case-sensitive: uppercase letters sort before lowercase), or textnocase.
sort_order
asc (the default) or desc.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Any other sort type throws an Expression exception. In a numeric sort a non-numeric element throws "Non-numeric value found in numeric sort".

Note that a text sort puts "10" before "9", because it compares character by character. Use numeric for numbers. ListSort does the same job for lists.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Words = ListToArray("modem,Browser,applet,Cookie")>
<CFSET Nums = ListToArray("10,9,100,1")>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySort(Nums, "numeric", "desc")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Call</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>numeric, desc</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Nums, ", ")#</TD></TR>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySort(Nums, "text")>
<TR><TD>text (on numbers!)</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Nums, ", ")#</TD></TR>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySort(Words, "text")>
<TR><TD>text</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Words, ", ")#</TD></TR>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySort(Words, "textnocase")>
<TR><TD>textnocase</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Words, ", ")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListSort, ArraySwap, ArrayToList
